name: A Grape Picker S Lunch  Sausages And Lentils With Thyme And Wine
instructions: Heat the oil in a large casserole dish such as a le creuset or dutch oven and over a medium heat fry the bacon until crispy
Remove the bacon and then add the sausages , brown them on all sides
Add the onion chunks and turn up the heat so that they soften and take on a crispy caramel colour
Put the sausages back into the dish and add the thyme , lentils and garlic , cook for a minute stirring all the time
Then add the stock or consomm and the wine
Lower the heat to a slow simmer and partially cover with a lid
Simmer for 35 minutes , or until the lentils are tender and the sausages cooked through
Season with salt and pepper to taste , and then crumble in the crispy bacon just before serving , with a few more fresh thyme leaves
Allow people to help themselves from the pot in the middle of the table
Serve with assorted salads , bread , cheese and a glass or three of wine !
